name: Pancakes
method: Mix all ingredients. Heat pan. Pour batter. Cook until golden. Flip and cook the other side.

name: Spaghetti Bolognese
ingredients: Spaghetti, Minced Beef, Tomato Sauce, Onion, Garlic
method: Brown the beef. Add onion and garlic. Pour tomato sauce. Simmer for 20 min. Serve over cooked spaghetti.

name: Omelette
method: Beat eggs with milk. Melt butter in pan. Pour eggs. Add cheese and ham. Fold and serve.

name: Caesar Salad
ingredients: Lettuce, Croutons, Parmesan, Caesar Dressing, Chicken
method: Grill chicken and slice. Toss lettuce with dressing. Add croutons, parmesan, and chicken.

name: Tomato Soup
ingredients: Tomatoes, Onion, Garlic, Vegetable Stock, Cream
method: Sauté onion and garlic. Add tomatoes and stock. Simmer 20 min. Blend smooth. Stir in cream.
